newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - April 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - April 13.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Investment in Jordan is not proceeding as expected, Jordanian premier says.
- Saudi Hollandi Bank posts 46.8 million riyal net profit in the first quarter of 1997.
- Governor of the Saudi holy city of Medina opens a power station built at a cost of 121 million Saudi riyals.
- Turkey buys a surveillance system to monitor its boundries with Iraq.
- Abu Dhabi's foreign trade in February was worth 1.2 billion dirhams.
- Crucial meeting in Doha on Sunday to help regional carrier Gulf Air against bankruptcy.
